svg.text: We combine a pre-trained retriever (Query Encoder + Document Index)

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif

svg.text: with a pre-trained seq2seq model (Generator) and fine-tune

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif

svg.text: end-to-end. For query x, we use Maximum Inner Product Search (MIPS)

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif

svg.text: to find the top-K documents z_i.

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif

svg.text: For final prediction y, we treat z as a latent variable and

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif

svg.text: marginalize over seq2seq predictions given different documents.

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif
